title: Fins Up Clearwater

services.name: Tours & Cruises
services.desc: Fins Up Clearwater’s Dolphin Tour & Island Adventure is a 2-hour Clearwater dolphin cruise with an island/sandbar stop. Departing from Clearwater Beach Marina, this family-friendly tour includes dolphin watching, wildlife spotting, and time to relax or explore a private island. Learn more about our Clearwater Dolphin Tour & Island Adventure A Clearwater sunset cruise with the bonus of dolphin sightings. We head into the Gulf for unobstructed sunset views, then enjoy the glow of Clearwater Harbor and bridge lights at twilight. Learn more about our Clearwater Dolphin Sunset Cruise Start your day on the water with a family-friendly Clearwater morning dolphin cruise - plus free donuts onboard.
